key_insight: A closed-form solution under a full-row-rank condition enables randomized tensor trace-ratio optimization through tensor least squares rather than tensor eigenproblems.
engineering_relevance: The approach targets computational and memory bottlenecks in high-dimensional tensor analysis while enabling discriminative feature selection.
method: Derive a closed-form tensor trace-ratio solution under the full-row-rank condition.
Build a randomized tensor least-squares solver with theoretical error bounds.
Combine the solution with tensor ℓ₂,₀ regularization for sparse multilinear discriminant analysis.
evidence_signal: Evaluations on multiple public real-world benchmarks report efficiency and scalability gains, with competitive classification accuracy on some datasets; the abstract provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Verify the full-row-rank condition before relying on the closed-form result; applicability outside that condition is not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Large-Scale Tensor Trace-Ratio Problem: Randomized Algorithm and Sparse Multilinear Discriminant Analysis via Closed-Form Solution
